newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian policeman kills Palestinian in Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian policeman kills Palestinian in Hebron.

text.p: A Palestinian policeman shot dead a Palestinian man at a roadblock in the West Bank town of Hebron on Monday, Palestinian sources said.
The victim was named as Issam Muhammed Gate, 29. Details of the incident were not immediately known.

Palestinian forces patrol the most of the city of 120,000 Palestinians since Israel handed it over to their control under a peace deal in January. Israeli troops guard an enclave inside the city where 400 Jewish settlers live and study.
